name: Hiresome
summary: Hiresome posts one role to many job boards, manages sponsored posts and job board budgets from one dashboard, and tracks which boards deliver candidates. Its pricing page lists Lite at $4 and Pro at $16 a month per recruiter on yearly billing, with an Enterprise plan by quote.

facts.text: The job boards page says the buyer stops logging into several job boards to post the same position.
The page says sponsored posts and job board budgets can be managed from one central dashboard.
The page says the buyer can track which job boards deliver the best candidates and adjust spending.
The pricing page lists Lite at a current price of $4 a month and a regular price of $6.15, billed yearly per recruiter.
The pricing page lists Pro at a current price of $16 a month and a regular price of $32, billed yearly per recruiter. Enterprise is listed as custom.

plans.name: Lite

hiddenCosts: The pricing page offers a free trial but does not state its length in the text we read. Quarterly billing is described as saving an extra 7 percent, and yearly billing an extra 20 percent.
The currency selector offers INR, USD and EUR. Only dollar amounts appear in the text we read.
